Change c0515. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): Years will pass, and you will have visitings of despair, and yet be tortured by hope.

1818 text: Oh! my beloved sister, the sickening failings of your heart-felt expectations are, in prospect, more terrible to me than my own death. But you have a husband, and lovely children; you may be happy: heaven bless you, and make you so!

1831 text: Oh! my beloved sister, the sickening failing of your heart-felt expectations is, in prospect, more terrible to me than my own death. But you have a husband, and lovely children; you may be happy: Heaven bless you, and make you so!

Diff: Oh! my beloved sister, the sickening [-failings-] {+failing+} of your heart-felt expectations [-are-] {+is+} , in prospect, more terrible to me than my own death. But you have a husband, and lovely children; you may be happy: [-heaven-] {+Heaven+} bless you, and make you so!

Context after (unchanged): My unfortunate guest regards me with the tenderest compassion.

result.rationale: Changes are grammatical number (failings/failing, are/is) with capitalization of Heaven; no shift in meaning. Subject-verb agreement adjustment is wording-level, and capital H is orthographic.
